mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS falling by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening cycle that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually indicates aggressive monetary tightening amid inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market deterioration (UNRATE rising by at least 0.3 percentage points over 3 months), negative equity returns occur as corporate earnings face pressure from reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by at least 0.3pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates significant labor market slack that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST rising by at least 0.5% over the prior month) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST rises by at least 0.5% over 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.3% monthly rates indicates expanding consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 0.3% monthly, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months) signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls by at least 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
